title: Wolfram: AI - LLM Distributed Inference Services

ms.promise: A docker container with an LLM application that's usable via command line and available via public download. Included will be the associated documentation for how to use it for inference.
ms.criteria:
The following acceptance criteria is as follows:
・Docker container with the LLM application available for download through public link
・Users can complete inference requests using the docker container via the command line
・Documentation sufficient to complete criteria 1 and 2 above, i.e. is getting and using the docker container for completing inference requests.
ms.report:
Milestone 1: Development of easy-to-deploy LLM Server

・Available here: https://hub.docker.com/r/gridrepublic/llm-server/tags
・Completes Milestone Output #1
・Covers Acceptance Criteria #1 and #2
・Documentation for use of container/application
・Available here: https://gridrepublic.org/docs/LLM+Server+Deployment+via+Docker
・Completes Milestone Output #2

・Walkthrough Video

Working code capable of running basic inference requests via WebUI.
Working code capable of running basic inference requests from Notebook.

ms.promise: A prototype distributed LLM service, with WebUI and Notebook interface. Inference requests are served by remote resources over the internet. Associated user documentation to facilitate use of this service will also be provided.
ms.criteria:
A) The prototype distributed LLM service will allow:
・Users to make inference requests via WebUI
・Users to make inference requests via Notebook interface

B) Documentation sufficient to complete criteria 1 and 2 above, i.e. make inference requests via WebUI and Notebook interface.
ms.report:
